source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ποταμών ο Ιερομάρτυρας Επίσκοπος Ηρακλείας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **Nothing in the corpus reads as him**: the name appears in no folder. **The display name and `office` both keep Egypt out of the display and in the office**, because the page says «Επίσκοπος Ηρακλείας της Αιγύπτου» and the corpus keeps saints of other Heracleas. **`confessor` is in `types`** on the imprisonment in the mines in 310, which he survived, as well as the martyrdom of 340. **Athanasius the Great is linked**, the page making him a warm defender of Athanasius and of the Orthodox faith. **The First Ecumenical Council and the synod of Tyre of 335 are named as councils he sat at**, which the corpus's schema holds as neither feast nor relation, so they stand in the life only. **Arius is named without a link.** **No `locations` object.** No hymn is printed.
